description: This file is a bitbake recipe fragment for configuring, building, and installing libgcc, including multilib support and symlink management.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment for libgcc, setting up directories and running the configure script.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles libgcc using oe_runmake with the specified build top directory.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs libgcc, moves libraries to appropriate directories, and cleans up redundant files.

methods.name: get_original_os
methods.description: Determines the original target OS string, adjusting for specific architectures like ARM.
